授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This course has a purpose of learning Electromagnetism by understanding Maxwell's equations. These equations are most influential equations in all of science. Radio, television, radar, wireless Internet access, and Bluetooth are all understood by Electromagnetism or Maxwell's equations.
This course is based on lectures, class tests and the final exam. Students are encouraged to attend all the lectures.
Course plan:
(1) Gauss’s law for electric fields
(2) Gauss’s law for magnetic fields
(3) Faraday’s law
(4) The Ampere-Maxwell law
(5) Electromagnetic wave
